exposure: Paily aorta clamp (PAC) application during cesarean hysterectomy
outcome: intraoperative clamp related complications (tears, bleeding, haematomas, ecchymosis)
postoperative clamp related complications (distal thromboembolic events, symptoms related to bowel ischemia)
cohort: This study included 17 women with histologically confirmed advanced Placenta Accreta Spectrum (PAS) who underwent subtotal or total Caesarean hysterectomy using a Paily aorta clamp.
finding: The Paily aorta clamp was found to be both safe and an effective tool in managing advanced Placenta Accreta Spectrum cases during cesarean hysterectomy, with a median estimated blood loss of 1.5L and no observed clamp site injuries or distal thromboembolic/bowel ischemia events.
followup_time: Not specified (mentioned 'during follow up' but no duration)
